files.full_content:
-- R-410: 零售帳戶多條件異常清單(條件 1 或條件 2 任一成立)
WITH base AS (
    SELECT t.*
    FROM txn_log t
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'PROMO' AS channel_name) p
           ON p.channel_name = t.channel_name
    WHERE p.channel_name IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(t.rev_flag, 'N') <> 'Y'
      AND t.tx_time >= @start_date AND t.tx_time < @end_date
), agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.account_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN b.op_code IN ('OP11','OP12') THEN 1 END) AS atm_cnt,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.op_code IN ('OP11','OP12') THEN b.amount END), 0) AS atm_amt,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN b.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03') AND b.amount > 1000 THEN b.amount END), 0) AS in_amt,
        COUNT(CASE
            WHEN b.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03') AND b.amount > 1000 THEN 1 END) AS in_cnt
    FROM base b
    GROUP BY b.account_id
)
SELECT agg.account_id, agg.atm_cnt, agg.atm_amt, agg.in_amt, agg.in_cnt
FROM agg
WHERE (atm_cnt >= 2 AND atm_cnt <= 3
       AND atm_amt >= 50000 AND atm_amt <= 100000
       AND in_amt >= 80000 AND in_amt <= 100000)
   OR (atm_cnt >= 4 AND atm_cnt <= 10
       AND atm_amt >= 90000 AND atm_amt <= 150000
       AND in_cnt >= 2 AND in_cnt <= 3);

_golden.intent: 把實測到的三種誤報放在同一個 MR 上:(1) 行銷活動排除改成反連接 (LEFT JOIN + IS NULL,右表是單列常數,被排除的列不會進輸出)曾被報「LEFT JOIN 造成列數膨脹」;(2) 小額入帳的過濾在條件聚合裡,曾被報 major 而 finding 自己寫「最終結果相同」;(3) CTE 裡算出的欄位在外層 WHERE 使用,T-SQL 合法,曾被報 blocker「別名不可在 WHERE 使用」。三者都與 mr_408 (依核定規格實作)行為相同,不得有 major/blocker,決策不得是 blocked。
